name: BADGE
tagline: Batch active learning that runs k-means++ seeding in the (probability-residual x penultimate-embedding) space — diverse and uncertain.
pseudocode:
1. For each unlabeled point, compute embedding $e_i$ and softmax probs $p_i$
2. Form gradient-embedding signal: residual $r_i = -p_i + \mathbb{1}[\arg\max p_i]$
3. Distance $d(i,c) = \|r_i\|^2\|e_i\|^2 + \|r_c\|^2\|e_c\|^2 - 2 (r_i^\top r_c)(e_i^\top e_c)$
4. Seed first center as the point maximizing $\|r\|^2 \|e\|^2$
5. Iteratively sample next centers with prob $\propto d^2$ (k-means++ on rank-1 outer products)
6. Return the $n$ chosen indices
diff_from_baseline: Ash et al., ICLR 2020 ('Deep Batch Active Learning by Diverse, Uncertain Gradient Lower Bounds'). Standard reference for batch-mode deep active learning.

name: BAIT (Fisher embeddings)
tagline: Picks a batch that maximally reduces a Fisher-information trace objective via forward selection plus backward pruning.
pseudocode:
1. Stream-build per-class Fisher embeddings $X_i \in \mathbb{R}^{C \times d}$ (random-projected to $d=128$ for memory)
2. Aggregate population Fisher $F$ and labeled Fisher $F_\ell$; init $M^{-1} = (\lambda I + (n_\ell/n_{tot}) F_\ell)^{-1}$
3. Filter to a candidate pool by entropy (top $4n$ or 512)
4. Forward selection: greedily add the candidate maximizing trace$(F\,M^{-1}\,X^\top(I + X M^{-1} X^\top)^{-1} X\,M^{-1})$ via Woodbury updates
5. Over-sample to $2K$, then backward-prune lowest-utility picks back to $K$
6. Return $K$ selected indices
diff_from_baseline: Ash et al., NeurIPS 2021 ('Gone Fishing: Neural Active Learning with Fisher Embeddings'). Memory-adapted (CPU-friendly) port of the original BAIT for the MLS-Bench harness.

name: BALD (MC-Dropout)
tagline: Selects examples maximizing mutual information between model parameters and predictions, estimated via N MC-dropout passes.
diff_from_baseline: Houlsby et al. 2011 (BALD); Gal et al. 2017 / Kirsch et al. NeurIPS 2019 (BatchBALD). Greedy single-point BALD with MC-dropout — disagreement-based informational acquisition.

name: Least Confidence
tagline: Pick the n unlabeled examples whose top-class probability is the lowest under the current classifier — pure uncertainty sampling.
diff_from_baseline: Lewis & Gale 1994 ('A Sequential Algorithm for Training Text Classifiers'). Classical uncertainty-sampling baseline.

name: Random sampling
tagline: Pick n unlabeled indices uniformly at random — control / lower-bound baseline.
pseudocode:
1. Let $U = \{i : \text{idxs\_lb}[i] = \text{False}\}$
2. Permute $U$ uniformly at random
3. Return the first $n$ entries
diff_from_baseline: Standard random-acquisition control. Reference baseline measured against any informed strategy.
